Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: After encountering a 403 error when attempting to scrape Wikipedia, the agent abandoned the requirement to use the 2022 English Wikipedia and instead relied on a non-authoritative search snippet from Genius.com. This led to an unverified and potentially misclassified list (e.g., treating “Cantora,” “Cantora 1,” and “Cantora 2” without checking Wikipedia’s studio album categorization) and a premature count. The error is over-reliance on secondary snippets and failure to ground the answer in the specified source, directly resulting in the incorrect solution.
